candidate_relations.label: Ischemic Stroke, acute, right MCA territory and left MCA territory
candidate_relations.reason: The bilateral MCA territory ischemic strokes are the presenting neurological manifestations of TTP in this case. The reference diagnosis is TTP, the underlying thrombotic microangiopathy characterized by thrombocytopenia, microangiopathic hemolytic anemia (schistocytes, elevated LDH, indirect hyperbilirubinemia, negative Coombs), and end-organ involvement including these strokes. C001 names only the end-organ manifestation, not the unifying diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Describes the neurological manifestation/complication of TTP rather than the underlying diagnosis of TTP itself

case_quality_flags: Classic TTP pentad partially present: thrombocytopenia, MAHA, neurological symptoms documented; fever mild; renal function not explicitly reported
Opiate use noted as potential trigger or confounding factor
